description: Check a video PACKAGE of the iDos Games video studio ({ spec, assets } — what the platform MCP's plan_video and generate_asset return) exactly as the studio will open it: the VideoSpec (format, style, set, cast, lines, captions, overrides), every asset, and that each own:/pack: ref of the spec is among the package's assets (lib: refs are the studio library — see search_assets on the platform MCP). With title_id it also returns the link that opens the package in that app's editor (https://{titleId}.idos.games/#videodata=…) — rebuild the link after you edit the package. Free, offline.

package.description: { spec, assets } — a VideoSpec and the assets it uses.

title_id.description: The app with the video studio, for the link (optional).

title: Validate a video package
